verdict.rationale: The product is itself a public REST API with first-party documentation: a quickstart, an API key flow, per-endpoint reference pages (web, news, local POIs, rich search, answers, suggestions, spell check), curl examples, a browser playground, an OpenAI-compatible answers endpoint and an llms.txt. Community threads confirm users obtaining and using API keys for agents, and a separate AI-inference plan exists for that use. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and deeper independent hands-on corroboration of the API itself.
